# Code Anchors: Draft-Time Ordering Block

- `components/skills/nxs-razor/SKILL.md` — the normative statement: where the block is written, why it is keyed on titles, why there is one block rather than a line per story, and that it dies at filing.
- `libs/scope-razor/src/ordering.ts` — parses the block and the necessity line, walks the graph into unlock order, and reports a story waiting on a story outside a chosen set.
- `libs/scope-razor/src/ordering.spec.ts` — pins the row grammar, the title normalization, the absent-versus-empty necessity distinction, and the unlock ordering.
- `libs/scope-razor/src/check.ts` — the ordering findings: a story with no row, a row naming no story, a blocker naming no story, and a cycle, each blocking only once the draft declares stories.
- `libs/scope-razor/src/labels.ts` — removes the whole block when the filing body is derived.
- `components/commands/nxs.epic.md` — writes the block while drafting, shows each story's blockers in the digest, and walks the block at filing to assign the sequence and the dependency edges.
